queries.title: Search queries
queries.description: Europe PMC query syntax. Leave empty to use the built-in TIDE set (breath counting, mind wandering, breath focus, body scan, open monitoring, students and exam stress). Each query also runs on PubMed.

maxPerQuery.title: Max papers per query and source
maxPerQuery.description: How many results to take from each source for each query.

openAccessOnly.title: Open access only
openAccessOnly.description: Only keep papers anyone can read for free.

includePubMed.title: Also search PubMed
includePubMed.description: Run each query on PubMed (NCBI E-utilities) too and merge the results.

fromYear.title: Published from year
fromYear.description: Ignore papers published before this year.

seedPmids.title: Always include these PubMed IDs
seedPmids.description: Key papers to include no matter what the searches return.
